name: Defensive Coverage Redistribution v2

supersedes.reason: repeated focal exclusion plus within-anchor demeaning can collapse the other-nine outcome into the negative excluded-focal matching-cost change

inherit.fixed_defender_ranks: D1-D10 by reference-attacker distance at t; canonical-ID tie break

unit.name: one period/time anchor
unit.reference_attacker: unique attacking outfield player nearest observed ball at t
unit.reference_tie_action: exclude anchor; never use player ID
unit.reference_semantics: geometric reference, not inferred ball carrier or tactical role

coverage_outcome.attacker_set: fixed nine non-reference attacking outfield players selected at t
coverage_outcome.defender_set: all ten defending outfield players fixed at t
coverage_outcome.optimization: minimum-cost injective matching; one defender unused
coverage_outcome.endpoint_quantity: G_else(u)=mean matched distance across the fixed other nine attackers

response_predictor.name: concurrent focal-local versus middle defender-relative path contrast

model.transformation: none; one physical row per anchor

uncertainty.resampling: independent anchor blocks within period; retain terminal partial blocks

shared_geometry_direction_null.transformation: rotate each anchor's complete internal defender displacement field by one common random angle while preserving start formation, centroid trajectory, ranks, D, and all leave-one-out-relative path lengths
shared_geometry_direction_null.pass: observed beta_D exceeds 95th percentile of valid null beta_D estimates

remote_response_comparator.pass: primary beta_D point estimate exceeds remote-comparator point estimate

focal_movement_trim.pass: trimmed beta_D positive and at least 50% absolute primary magnitude retained

synthetic_gates: symmetric_defensive_expansion: global cost may change while local contrast is neutral
independent_other_attacker: cost change with neutral response
near_tie_assignment_switch: no artificial large scalar jump
reference_relationship_only: neutral elsewhere cost while full matching changes
direction_null: exact centroid and leave-one-out path preservation

classification.INVALID: frozen hash, sample/support, unique-reference, complete-set, full-rank, solver, bootstrap-minimum, synthetic-gate, null-preservation, hard-QC, or deterministic-serialization failure
classification.NOT_SUPPORTED: valid primary beta_D at or below zero
classification.COHERENT: valid beta_D above zero; 95% interval strictly above zero; direction null passes; primary exceeds remote comparator; frozen trim passes
classification.MIXED: every other valid execution with primary beta_D above zero
